name: Signed Distance Field Sampler from Mesh
definition: Creates a signed distance sampler function from a THREE.Mesh instance. Returns a function that computes the shortest signed distance to the mesh at a given world-space coordinate. Negative values indicate the point is inside the mesh, positive values indicate it is outside.
summary: This utility validates a Three.js mesh, updates its world matrix, and delegates distance computation to a geometry sampler, returning a function that calculates signed distances to the mesh surface.
